Alex (AE): Kicking off a POC with Galena Health. They want a 2h soak at sustained 550 qps, ~768-token outputs, p99 <190ms, errors <0.8%. Need run plan, quick sizing, and cost for steady + burst. Also they asked for SOC answers. Can SE/SRE + Solutions scope?
Mei (SE): On it. A couple quicks: what % streaming vs full-response, and % cacheable prompts?
Alex (AE): ~55% streaming, ~50% repeatable templates (good cache hit).
Pri (SWE): Proposed load plan: warmup 15m, ramp 10m to 550 qps, 2h steady, 10m cooldown. Arrival model: Poisson + scheduled microbursts: every 25m a 30s spike @3x to exercise tails. Models to test: rwd-7b-q8 (fast), rwd-13b-q4 (balance), rwd-14b-8k (quality). Enable KV prefix cache and first-token streaming.
Pri (SWE): sample command we use:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-q4 --target-qps 550 --duration 7800 --ramp 600 --warmup 900 --burst-profile "every_25m:30s@3x" --concurrency 90 --payload-dist galena_prompts.json
```
Omar (SRE): Infra rec: Dedicated pool sized to cover 660 qps (20% headroom). Autoscale min=1 max=3 nodes, cooldown 90s. Multi-AZ recommended for demo. Fallback policy: 13b->7b to preserve latency. Pre-populate KV during ramp. Reduce max_batch_delay for this latency-sensitive route if needed.
Jules (Solutions): Quick pricing ballpark: Dedicated pool for rwd-13b-q4 to sustain 550 qps ~ $1,100/hr. 2h run + warmup/cooldown ~= $2.5k. Burst node / extra capacity adds ~+18% hourly. Hosted token estimate ~ $0.21 per 1k inferred tokens (very rough). Will attach redacted SOC checklist after pull.
load-bot: quick smoke run results:
```json
{"test":"galena-smoke-2026-04-02","target_qps":550,"sustained_qps":547,"p50_ms":44,"p95_ms":120,"p99_ms":197,"error_rate_pct":0.6,"gpu_util_pct":82,"notes":"p99 197ms slightly above 190ms SLO. Options: bump capacity +20% or lower max_batch_delay to 5ms."}
```
Mei (SE): p99 197ms 99close. Fastest path to SLO: either spin +20% capacity or drop max_batch_delay from 8ms -> 5ms. Which is quicker for infra?
Omar (SRE): Spinning +20% is fastest; I'll provision extra capacity and run a 30m validation at steady 550 qps in ~1h. If still high, Pri can push batch_delay change.
Pri (SWE): I can also stage a config change to drop batch_delay to 5ms after the capacity test if needed. Will stand by.
load-bot: 30m validation post +20% capacity:
```json
{"test":"galena-val-2026-04-02","target_qps":550,"sustained_qps":551,"p50_ms":40,"p95_ms":110,"p99_ms":183,"error_rate_pct":0.4,"gpu_util_pct":75,"notes":"p99 183ms meets <190ms SLO with +20% capacity. Recommend final 2h soak with same config and KV pre-warm."}
```
Jules (Solutions): I'll update the pricing sheet with two lines: baseline and +20% capacity delta (~+$200/hr). Also prepping a short SOC redacted bundle for Galena.
Alex (AE): Awesome 99That's inside acceptance. Customer criteria: sustained 550 qps for 2h, p99 <190ms, <0.8% errors. I'll schedule the full soak once Solutions shares SOC doc. Thanks team :tada:
